description:
About Dash0

Join Dash0 and help us define the future of observability. We are OpenTelemetry-native, building a delightful, simple, and AI-centric platform that eliminates vendor lock-in and meaningless toil. Shape a product developers love, with transparent pricing and built-in cost control.

Are you ready to shape the moments that make developers fall in love with a product?

At Dash0, we're not just building another observability tool; we're on a mission to bring observability closer to the developers; make it a part of their everyday work. We believe that getting deep insights should be easy and accessible. Our customers praise our simpler solution that empowers developers, and we're scaling fast. We're looking for Product Engineers to drive growth from inside the product: the first login, the first insight, and every moment that decides whether a developer stays. And that's where you come in!

The Challenge You'll Tackle:

  • Make the first five minutes count. Developers decide fast whether a tool is worth their time. Your challenge is to design and build onboarding flows, using React, TypeScript and our Go backend, that take a new user from sign-up to their first meaningful insight as quickly as possible.

  • Listen to our users at scale. From "how did you hear about us?" to cancellation feedback, you'll build in-product surveys and in-app messaging that reach the right user at the right moment, without ever getting in their way.

  • Turn data into personal journeys. As we grow, you'll lay the foundations for personalized user pathways, so Dash0 adapts to each user's stack, role and goals. You'll own the full loop: instrument, ship, measure, iterate.

  • Champion the user, and the numbers. You will work closely with product, design, marketing and backend engineers, and you'll care as much about the activation metric as about the code behind it. This is where we need you to be a Product Engineer, not just a software developer!

What Success Looks Like (and How You'll Get There):

  • Within 1 week, you'll have shipped your first piece of production code.

  • Within 3 months, you'll have shipped our in-product survey and in-app messaging capabilities, giving the whole company a direct line to what our users think.

  • Within 6 months, you'll have reworked key onboarding flows and be able to show their impact on activation, backed by data you instrumented yourself. You'll be working alongside some very talented engineers who are eager to collaborate and learn with you.

  • Within 12 months, you'll have played a pivotal role in building personalised user pathways and be the go-to expert for growth engineering at Dash0.

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has 4–5+ years of experience as a full-stack engineer, building production applications with React and TypeScript.

  • Is comfortable on the backend in Go and/or Java, and enjoys owning a feature end to end, from UI to API to data.

  • Expertly leverages AI and agentic coding tools every day to accelerate development, applying deep technical judgment to verify, refine, and own the final output.

  • Learns fast and loves picking up whatever the problem needs.

  • Is a great teammate: curious, low ego, and a clear communicator.

  • Thrives in a fast-paced startup environment where you can make a huge impact.

  • Bonus: has worked with product analytics tools (e.g., PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Segment, ClickHouse).

  • Bonus: has experience with growth, onboarding or experimentation, or has built developer tools or observability products.

Why Dash0?

  • Real Impact: See your work directly shape how developers discover, adopt and stay with Dash0.

  • Brilliant Team: Learn from and contribute to a team of highly talented and passionate engineers. We value learning and growth!

  • Product-Market Fit: We're solving a real problem with a product that's gaining serious traction.

  • Fully Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere in Europe with competitive salary and stock options.

Ready to build the future of observability with us? Apply now!

Why Dash0

This is a unique opportunity to help build a generational company. Dash0 is backed by top-tier investors including Balderton Capital, Accel, and Cherry Ventures, and led by a founding team with decades of experience in observability. We're in the middle of a massive growth phase after our Series B, and we're just getting started.

If you're looking for a place where a great product meets great people, where momentum is real, and your impact is visible from day one — this is it.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary & meaningful equity participation; you'll own part of what you're building

  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with offices in New York, Amsterdam, and Munich

  • €60/month Lifestyle allowance

  • Location-specific benefits

  • Collaborative, fast-moving team culture with a builder mindset

  • Clear path for career growth and development

  • Direct access to founders and leadership
